brief_summary: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the pharmacokinetics of evolocumab after a single 140 mg subcutaneous (SC) dose in aduts with normal renal function or severe renal impairment or end-stage renal disease (ESRD) receiving hemodialysis.
brief_title: Estimation Study to Assess the Effect of Severe Renal Impairment and End-stage Renal Disease Hemodialysis on the Pharmacokinetics of Evolocumab

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index (BMI) of ≥ 18 and ≤ 35 kg/m² at screening.
* Subjects will have low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) of 70-190 mg/dL (inclusive) and on statin therapy.
* Other inclusion criteria may apply.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject with current or prior history of statin intolerance
* Subject has previously received Evolocumab (AMG 145) or any other investigational therapy directed against PCSK9
* Known substance abuse (eg, alcohol, licit or illicit drugs) within 12 months of day -1
* Testing positive for alcohol and/or drugs-of-abuse at screening, day -1, or day 1 (alcohol only)
* History of hypersensitivity or allergic reaction to mammalian-derived drug preparations
* Known sensitivity to any of the active substances or their excipients to be administered during dosing, eg, carboxymethylcellulose
* Other exclusion criteria may apply.

official_title: Phase 1, Open-label, Single-dose Study of Evolocumab (AMG 145) Administered Subcutaneously to Subjects With Normal Renal Function or Severe Renal Impairment or End Stage Renal Disease Receiving Hemodialysis

primary_outcomes.measure: Maximum Observed Serum Concentration (Cmax) of Evolocumab
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Predose and 4 hours, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 15, 22, 29, 43, 50 and 57 days postdose

primary_outcomes.measure: Area Under the Concentration-time Curve From Time 0 to Time of Last Quantifiable Concentration (AUC0-last) for Evolocumab
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Predose and 4 hours, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 15, 22, 29, 43, 50 and 57 days postdose
